title: Rydberg atom-based sensors for radio-frequency electric field metrology, sensing, and communications (Review)
abstract: Comprehensive review of Rydberg atom-based sensors from Army Research Lab. Covers fundamental physics (EIT, Autler-Townes), sensitivity analysis across the full spectrum (DC to THz), comparison with classical antennas, dynamic range, and defense applications. Reports sensitivity on order of nV/cm/sqrt(Hz) experimentally verified.
key_claims: Coverage DC to THz with single sensor type
Absolute SI-traceable measurement at 0.1% precision level, >10x classical antenna improvement
First team to achieve wide-bandwidth continuous Rydberg spectrum coverage (2021)
ARL lead researchers: Meyer, Cox, Kunz
